weapon_changes.description: This change was made in Patch 12.09 for PC and is now being implemented for Console as we previously mentioned in the [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/news/game-updates/valorant-patch-notes-12-09/ Patch 12.09 Patch Notes.]

bug_fixes: Agents
Clove
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Clove’s Not Dead Yet first person and third person SFX were not playing when the ability was available and when the ability timed out.
Gekko
Bugfix Buff Fixed an issue where Gekko’s reclaimable ability globules would disappear after using Thrash.
Miks
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Miks was getting assists for healing uninjured allies with M-pulse.
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Miks’ M-pulse could not be toggled after quickly swapping between abilities.
Raze
Bugfix Buff Fixed an issue where Raze'sBlast Pack wasn't dealing damage to destructible enemy abilities.
Sage
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Sage’s Healing Orb was not usable during the buy phase.
Viper
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Viper's Pit was getting stuck unable to expand in a few specific spots.
Maps
Breeze
Bugfix Fixed a bug on Breeze that allowed multiple Agent abilities to lock onto enemies who were out of sight behind the large boxes on A Main.
Store
Bugfix Fixed an overlap issue on buy button prompts in Arabic while previewing bundles.
Agents
Waylay
We’re aware of the issue with Waylay where she can place her Refract on a roof on Ascent.
Maps
Lotus
We’re aware of the issue on Lotus where the doors sometimes don’t open.
V26A3 Contender and Invite Division schedule changes:
Playoffs now take place across multiple days.
The first round of playoffs will be on June 20
Teams that advance from the first round return on June 21 for their next matchup
Make sure to check the schedule in client for round start times for your zone!
Premier
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Premier team tags would not show up in the Buy menu during pre-round phase.
Bugfix Added clearer error messaging during the ‘Create Team’ flow when a name and tag is already taken.
Cypher
Bugfix Buff Fixed an issue where you couldn't see the Cypher camera model when placing the ability.
